candidates.snippet: The prominent Kremlin-affiliated Russian milblogger agreed with ISW’s assessment, acknowledging that Ukraine’s successes will delay Russia’s offensive on Slovyansk — the Russian objective after the seizure of Lyman itself. (4/5)
Ukraine’s Operation Vivaldi has achieved the operationally-significant objective of disrupting the Russian effort to conduct a wide encirclement of Ukraine's Fortress Belt. (3/5)
